instrument: Washington State Environmental Policy Act, as applied to the Wallula Gap application
summary: Counsel for two organizations has asked Walla Walla County to require additional information or issue a determination of significance, which would trigger a full environmental impact statement for the proposed facility.

source.citation: Regional reporting of an Earthjustice letter on behalf of the Walla Walla Anti-Data Center League and Columbia Riverkeeper, 2026

notes: Washington has a state environmental review statute. Oregon does not have a comparable general-purpose analogue. Two states on the same river, with the same utility economics and the same corridor, present different review paths for an identical project because of a difference in state law. California's equivalent produced the Imperial County ruling voiding approvals granted without review.
confidence_note: Neither the statute nor the letter has been read. The determination-of-significance standard, who decides it and on what record, is NOT_CHECKED. Whether the county has acted is unknown.
